module_name: Git fundamentals: init add commit push
catchbook_deliverable: CatchBook repository initialized on GitHub with professional README, .gitignore, and initial project structure. First meaningful commit demonstrates version control proficiency.
description: Master the core Git workflow for version control. Learn to initialize repositories, track changes, write meaningful commit messages, and sync work with GitHub. Apply these skills immediately by setting up the CatchBook project repository with proper documentation and structure.
learning_objectives: Explain the purpose of version control and why it's essential for CatchBook development
Initialize a Git repository and configure user settings
Stage and commit changes with clear, descriptive messages
Connect local repository to GitHub and push commits
Write a professional README that communicates CatchBook's vision and setup instructions
Create a .gitignore file to exclude unnecessary files from version control
Establish a clean initial project structure for CatchBook

lessons.title: Version control concepts and why Git matters
Git installation, configuration, and first repository
The staging area, commits, and commit messages
Connecting to GitHub and pushing your first CatchBook commit

dependencies: VS Code or preferred text editor
